name: report_fire
description: Call as soon as the caller names anything near them. Creates an incident (merges are only suggested to the dispatcher).

landmark_text.description: Caller's exact words about where they are: store, school, church, park, road

lat.description: Caller latitude if known from the phone/client. Never invent.

lon.description: Caller longitude if known from the phone/client. Never invent.

phone.description: Caller E.164 if the telephony stack provides it
